descriptionHtml:
About The Company

The Company is a leading global technology and services organization providing industry-standard enterprise solutions.

Job Summary & Roles

  • Collaborate with cross-functional development teams to build scalable software and data solutions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code following best engineering practices.
  • Participate in agile sprints, bug fixes, performance optimization, and system testing.

Eligibility & Qualifications

  • Degree: BE / B.Tech (All Branches), BCA, MCA, B.Sc (Computer Science / IT), Any Graduate.
  • Batch: 2024, 2025 & 2026 Batch Freshers.

title: Datavail Junior SQL Developer Off Campus Drive Freshers Apply Now
overview: Datavail is hiring Junior SQL Developer Freshers through an Off Campus Drive. Eligible branches include BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA (2024, 2025, 2026 Batches). Read detailed eligibility criteria, skills, and direct apply link below.
descriptionHtml:
About Datavail

Datavail is a leading global data management and cloud managed services company with more than 1,000 data professionals assisting clients worldwide. Datavail provides round-the-clock database administration, cloud migrations, analytics, and enterprise application services.

Job Summary & Key Responsibilities

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and triggers.
  • Assist senior database engineers in database performance tuning, indexing, and troubleshooting query bottlenecks.
  • Participate in data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) data pipelines.
  • Work closely with application developers to ensure reliable database schema design.
  • Perform routine health checks, backup verification, and database monitoring.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Education: B.E / B.Tech (CS, IT, ECE), BCA, MCA, B.Sc (Computer Science / IT).
  • Batch Eligibility: 2024, 2025 & 2026 Batch Freshers.
  • Minimum Marks: 60% or 6.0 CGPA throughout academics (10th, 12th, Graduation).
  • Experience: Freshers (0 to 1 Year).

Required Skills

  • Strong foundational knowledge of RDBMS concepts (Relational Database Management Systems).
  • Proficiency with SQL (SELECT, JOINs, Subqueries, Aggregate Functions, Group By, DDL, DML).
  • Basic understanding of database systems such as MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
  • Good verbal and written English communication skills.

Selection Process

  1. Online Technical & Aptitude Assessment (SQL Query writing + Logical Reasoning).
  2. Technical Interview (SQL, Data Structures, DB Fundamentals).
  3. Managerial / HR Discussion.

title: Amazon Software Development Engineer (SDE) Intern Off Campus Hiring
overview: Amazon is inviting applications for Software Development Engineer (SDE) Internships across Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Pune. Pre-final and final year engineering students (2025 & 2026 Batches) are eligible to apply.
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking.

Role Description

As an SDE Intern, you will collaborate with experienced software engineers to design, build, and deploy high-scale distributed systems, web services, and cloud solutions on AWS.

Key Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's Degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • Graduation Year: 2025 or 2026.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern language: Java, C++, Python, or C#.
  • Solid understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
  • Familiarity with Object-Oriented Design (OOD) and modular programming concepts.
